nodes.description: Derived contract constructor that forwards token, beneficiary and releaseTime to the TokenTimelock base constructor.
Base constructor validating releaseTime_ against block.timestamp and initializing _token, _beneficiary and _releaseTime.
Public function that checks block.timestamp and transfers the whole held token balance to the beneficiary via SafeERC20.
View getter returning the held ERC20 token address.
View getter returning the beneficiary address.
View getter returning the release timestamp.
IERC20 token contract being held by the timelock.
Address receiving the tokens on release.
Timestamp after which release() is allowed.
Block timestamp used in the constructor guard and in the release() time check.
Caller of the unrestricted public release() function.
External call transferring tokens to the beneficiary, executed through SafeERC20 low level call; potential reentrancy entry point.
Constructor parameter holding the ERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter holding the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter holding the release timestamp.
Local variable holding the timelock token balance before transfer.

edges.reason: Derived constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor with the same arguments.
token_ parameter is written into the _token state variable.
beneficiary_ parameter is written into the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime_ parameter is written into the _releaseTime state variable.
Constructor require uses block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
release() authorization depends on block.timestamp >= _releaseTime (timestamp dependency).
release() reads the _releaseTime state variable in its time check.
release() is public and has no owner check, so any msg.sender can trigger the transfer.
release() reads _token to query balance and to transfer.
The token contract stored in _token is the target of the external safeTransfer call.
_beneficiary is passed as the recipient of the token transfer.
The balance amount is forwarded to the external safeTransfer call before any state update.
release() performs an external token transfer as its last statement with no reentrancy guard.
A malicious token contract can re-enter release() during safeTransfer since no guard is present.
release() reads _beneficiary as the transfer destination.
release() stores the result of _token.balanceOf(address(this)) in the local amount.
token() getter returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() getter returns the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime() getter returns the _releaseTime state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter token_ is only used inside the TokenTimelock constructor to initialize _token, so it can be merged into that core function.
Parameter beneficiary_ is only used inside the TokenTimelock constructor to initialize _beneficiary, so it can be merged into that core function.
Parameter releaseTime_ is only used inside the TokenTimelock constructor for the timestamp require and _releaseTime initialization, so it can be merged into that core function.
Local variable amount is produced only to be consumed by the unsafe safeTransfer operation in release(), so it can be merged into that unsafe operation node.
